projects.title: WebFrontDesk
projects.description:
•	Designed and developed an enterprise level RESTful web application using Spring Roo, Hibernate and MySQL.
•	Integrated Spring Security plugin with various User Roles using JDBC user service.
•	Created custom Post Authentication Filter to set various values in session at the time user logs in.
•	Created custom AuthenticationSuccess Handler to redirect users based on their roles if there is no SavedRequest present.
•	Customized the Spring Roo tag library to accommodate DOJO time selector functionality.
•	Tweaked Spring Roo generated page to dynamically change the dropdown list based on other dropdown list value using DOJO AJAX call to the controller. (eg. Country and Province)
•	Generated reports in XLS and PDF format using Apache POI and PDFBox
